signals.title_or_quote: ✍️ Implement git-based editorial workflow for content management
signals.why_relevant: Seeks Git-based content workflow for newsletters.
signals.drafted_reply: I built a tool for exactly this: lettercraft lets you write in Markdown, store posts in your own Git repo, and publish with a git push. Code blocks render perfectly across email clients. It's free up to 1,000 subscribers.

rescore.why: The thread explicitly seeks a git-based editorial workflow for content management using Markdown and version control, which directly aligns with the app's core functionality of storing posts in Git and publishing via git push.
